svg.text: Farm Connect — Database Query Lifecycle & Pool Mechanics
Complete trace of SQL query dispatch, client acquisition from pg.Pool, SSL execution, and connection return

g.text: 1. NODE-POSTGRES CLIENT POOL (SRC/CONFIG/DB.JS)
1. Application Query Dispatch
• Controller calls db.query(sql, [param1, param2])
• Parameterised inputs prevent SQL injection vulnerabilities
• Returns native JavaScript Promise to calling async controller
productController.js
2. Pool Client Acquisition (pg.Pool)
• Pool checks out an active connection (max: 10 prod / 5 dev)
• If all clients busy: Waits up to connectionTimeoutMillis: 2000ms
• Fails fast if DB unreachable rather than hanging HTTP requests
• Reuses warm sockets to eliminate 3-way TCP handshake overhead
src/config/database.js
3. SSL Encrypted Socket Transmission
• Establishes TLS encrypted session over TCP port 5432
• SSL config: rejectUnauthorized: false in production (Supabase requirement)
• Formats query into PostgreSQL frontend/backend protocol binary packet
• Socket keepalive enabled to detect dropped cloud connections
TCP Wire Protocol
4. Connection Return & Leak Protection
• Pool automatically releases client when db.query() finishes
• In transactions: executeTransaction() uses finally { client.release(); }
• Guaranteed release prevents connection starvation under high load
• Idle timeout: Closes connections unused for > 30,000ms
client.release()
2. POSTGRESQL SERVER ENGINE (SUPABASE)
1. Query Parser & Syntax Verification
• Validates SQL grammar and parses parameter placeholders ($1, $2, $3)
• Verifies table permissions and column existence in catalog
• Binds passed parameters to strongly-typed internal variables
• Generates abstract parse tree for query planner
SQL Parser
2. Query Planner & Index Selection
• Evaluates scan strategies: Index Scan vs Bitmap Index Scan vs Seq Scan
• Utilizes composite index on farmers(latitude, longitude)
• Utilizes foreign key index on products(farmer_id)
• Determines join order (products JOIN farmers via Nested Loop / Hash Join)
EXPLAIN ANALYZE
3. Spatial Execution: calculate_distance_km
• Calls stored PL/pgSQL function calculate_distance_km()
• Computes spherical Haversine formula for each candidate farm
• Filters rows where distance_km <= radius (e.g. 25km)
• Sorts result rows: ORDER BY distance_km ASC
Haversine Execution
4. Result Serialization & Wire Dispatch
• Serializes row records into PostgreSQL data row packets
• Streams bytes over TLS TCP socket back to Node.js backend
• node-postgres converts records to JavaScript Array of Objects
• Resolves to { rows: [...] } object inside Express controller
JSON Response Ready
